scope: Full original dataflow and complete RAM/CPU/FPU/FPUL/MACL/stop state for guarded scale and translation. Independent exact rational matrix/write-footprint checks for narrow finite dyadic cases. Native scalar/vector numerical backends have earlier separately scoped proofs.
limitations: Vector differential arithmetic uses a separate adapter to the same pinned upstream core; this validates wiring/dataflow, not independent hardware arithmetic. Rational checks are separate and use exactly representable dyadic matrices.
Reached PR/SZ/RM/trap/RAM boundary tests do not implement CPU exception delivery or prove universal hardware behavior. No scene/pixel/frame-rate claim.
Earlier limited matrix implementations and evidence are preserved; no duplicate credit for their source.
